stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: What did this commit even change?

stations.title: History
stations.text: One commit's whole message is one word.
stations.note: Nobody can tell what it did.

stations.title: Next year
stations.say: So that's why postage went up.

captions: Wilma reads the shop's history and cannot tell what one commit did.
Postage is changing too, and a bare commit would not say why.
You reword Femi's commit and write a message with a what and a why, in three tasks.
Each commit now says what it changed, and the postage commit says why.
A reader next year understands the history without asking anyone.
